locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Reposted 1 day ago · Over 100 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
jobDescription:
About the job
SPECIALIST, BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT & AUTOMATION (Open only to Vietnames.e candidates) Location: CMC Creative Space, No. 19 Street, Tan Thuan Dong Ward, HCMCWorking Time: 9AM – 6PM. Monday - FridayLanguage Proficiency: English (B2 level)
About the jobGet to know the role We are looking for a new Specialist to join one of our Business Process Improvement Teams. We believe a successful candidate has great problem solving, project management and excellent communication skills to bridge between business stakeholders and automation engineers. You will get to innovate solutions to increase efficiency, lower manpower requirements & help solve pressing problems across the organization. Your work will have a huge impact on business operations by improving the performance and SLA of processes.The Day-to-Day Activities You will manage end to end business improvement and automation projects regionally, across all departments and functional areas. The good to haves 2+ years of experience at a top-tier strategy consulting firmKnowledge of project management approaches, tools, and phases of the project lifecycleCertification in Six Sigma, LEAN, Agile, PMP practicesReadiness to travel 20-40% of the time

title: Product Development Officer
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 3 weeks ago · 78 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
jobDescription:
About the job
POSITION PURPOSE:The Product Development Office is responsible for supporting and independently managing assigned workstreams in the development, enhancement, launch, and ongoing management of life insurance products. The role works closely with cross-functional teams and distribution channels to ensure product initiatives are delivered in line with business strategy, regulatory requirements, customer needs, and agreed timelines. This level is expected to handle more complex assignments, provide stronger project coordination, and contribute practical recommendations to improve product performance and operational efficiency.PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:Product Development and Implementation Support and manage assigned product development initiatives from concept, design, approval, implementation, launch, and post-launch review.Coordinate with Actuarial, Legal, Compliance, Operations, IT, Finance, Marketing, Training, and Distribution teams to ensure product deliverables are completed accurately and on time.Prepare and maintain product documents, approval papers, product specifications, implementation trackers, and launch readiness materials.Proactively identify implementation risks, propose practical solutions, and follow up with stakeholders to resolve issues.
Product Portfolio and Performance Management Monitor assigned life insurance products to ensure product information, rules, processes, and operational requirements are properly maintained.Track product performance, customer feedback, distribution feedback, and operational issues to identify areas for improvement.Support product enhancement initiatives, including benefit changes, process improvements, sales support materials, and product governance requirements.
Market Research and Product Insights Collect and analyze market, competitor, customer, and distribution insights to support product development and enhancement proposals.Prepare market research summaries, product benchmarking, and recommendation papers for internal discussion and management review.Provide more independent analysis and practical recommendations on product positioning, features, and customer value proposition.
Business Support and Stakeholder Coordination Work with distribution channels to understand business needs and support the development of suitable product solutions, sales narratives, and launch materials.Provide product-related support with training, marketing, sales, and operations teams to ensure consistent understanding of product features and benefits.Maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to support smooth product implementation and ongoing management.
JOB SPECIFICATION Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Finance, Insurance or a related field.Experience: Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in life insurance product development, product management, business analysis, project coordination, or related functions.Skills:
Good project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage timelines, follow up deliverables, and work across multiple stakeholders.Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret product, market, and business information.Effective communication, presentation, and people skills in working with both business and technical teams.Good command of English and Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel; Demonstrate stronger independence, ownership, and problem-solving capability.

title: Sustainable Foods Sales Corporate Policy Program Manager
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 2 days ago · 42 people clicked applyPromoted by hirer · Responses managed off LinkedIn
jobDescription:
About the job
Company DescriptionCalling all ambitious, personable deal makers who want a job with meaning! Want a full-time job working from home (some travel required) at a job that makes the world a better place? Set your own full-time hours, with room for growth, a competitive salary, and a results-driven atmosphere. This is a great job for resourceful, influential, and self-directed people who are highly skilled at interpersonal negotiation and sales, who are bold and resilient, and who want to do work that makes an impactful difference. Learn more and apply at: https://lever-foundation.breezy.hr/p/3b0f54876ba9-sustainable-food-sales-manager-vietnamAbout Lever FoundationLever Foundation is a global non-profit that focuses on creating a more humane and sustainable protein supply chain in Asia and beyond. We work with large food companies and suppliers to secure commitments to more sustainable and higher-welfare practices. Our partners include leading food and beverage and hospitality companies such as Burger King, Marriott, Jollibee, KFC, and many others.In recent years, in response to increasing concern for sustainability and animal welfare, hundreds of food companies operating in Asia have set corporate policies to source only “cage-free” eggs, which are far more humane for animals and much higher in food safety. Lever Foundation has helped secure policies on this topic and other food sustainability topics, such as sustainable protein and plant-based foods, from over 250 companies in Asia and beyond. You can learn more about Lever at: https://www.leverfoundation.org . Job DescriptionAs a Sustainability Program Manager, you will proactively reach out and build relationships with decision-makers at leading food companies. You will help educate these companies on the environmental, animal welfare, and economic benefits of implementing stronger sustainable food sourcing policies, such as the use of cage-free eggs, in their supply chain. You will provide industry updates, connect these companies with potential suppliers, and provide other resources to help them understand and set targets on the issue. In order to identify and engage with top management of the new food companies, you will actively network and outreach by doing online research, writing and sending emails, making calls, and conducting visits and meetings with companies. You get the benefits of working from home with flexible hours, and you’ll have wonderful colleagues around Asia and beyond to work with you and support you. Through this work, you will have hands-on experience working with leading food companies on corporate sustainability, with room for advancement to managerial or other positions.Learn more and apply at: https://lever-foundation.breezy.hr/p/3b0f54876ba9-sustainable-food-sales-manager-vietnamQualificationsWe do not require any particular educational or work background, although prior experience in sales, negotiation, business development, or similar sales- or advocacy-style work is a very strong plus.We're looking for an aspiring candidate with the following personality traits and skills needed to succeed in this job: Extroverted and proactive in building relationships and personal networksExcellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and be highly engaging and persuasiveAbility to work independently, with a very strong work ethic and a can-do mentalityAbility to remain resilient and motivated when you are brushed offPersonal interest in sustainability, animal welfare, or public HealthMust be fluent in Vietnamese and conversational or fluent in English
Learn more and apply at: https://lever-foundation.breezy.hr/p/3b0f54876ba9-sustainable-food-sales-manager-vietnam

title: Planning Analyst
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 6 days ago · Over 100 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Company review time is typically 1 week
jobDescription:
About the job
GENERAL FUNCTIONThe Wolverine supply chain planning team optimizes product planning, inventory management, and factory planning across global brands and sourcing partners. The Planning & Optimization Analyst supports global supply chain planning, sourcing, and operations teams by transforming complex data into reliable reporting, dashboards, insights, and optimization models. This role is expected to independently manage data preparation, validation, analysis, and publication processes; maintain a strong control mindset; identify root causes behind variances or abnormal results; and use technical tools such as Power BI, Excel, SQL, Python, and automation methods to improve planning accuracy, process efficiency, and decision quality.PRIMARY DUTIESResponsible for analytical reporting, data transformation, and optimization modeling that improve inventory management and planning execution, while supporting the day-to-day planning playbook to drive consistent, accurate, repeatable, and auditable performance. Independently manage end-to-end data transformation from raw inputs through cleansing, validation, reconciliation, reporting, and publication.Build and maintain validation checks, sanity checks, and exception controls to ensure data integrity, traceability, and reliable reporting outputs.Develop financial, operational, inventory, and capacity models to optimize inventory flow, buy planning, factory loading, and planning decision-making.Create and enhance dashboards, Power BI reports, and KPI scorecards that measure performance across brands, regions, factories, and planning processes.Use SQL, Python, Excel, Power Query, Power Pivot, DAX, VBA, or other automation tools to streamline recurring reporting, reduce manual effort, and improve analytical scalability.Analyze variances, abnormal outputs, and unexpected results; perform root-cause analysis using source data, transaction records, and process knowledge before escalation.Translate analytical findings into clear business insights, recommended actions, and preventive process improvements for planning, sourcing, operations, and leadership stakeholders.Maintain, document, and evolve the global planning playbook, including process steps, business logic, data definitions, controls, and reporting standards.Lead or support planning tool master data management, ensuring accuracy, governance, and alignment with planning and reporting requirements.Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability by delivering accurate outputs on time, proactively communicating risks, and following through until issues are resolved.Apply feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve work quality, prevent repeat issues, and strengthen analytical capability across the planning process.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED Advanced analytical capability with strong attention to detail, data integrity, data reconciliation, and exception-management discipline.Strong proficiency in Excel, including advanced formulas, Power Query, Power Pivot, and data modeling; VBA, Power Automate or automation experience preferred.Hands-on experience with Power BI, including data modeling, DAX measures, dashboard design, refresh validation, and user-friendly visualization.Working knowledge of SQL for querying, joining, validating, and reconciling data across multiple sources; ability to understand relational data structures and dependencies.Python coding capability for data manipulation, automation, validation, and scalable analysis using common libraries such as pandas and openpyxl; experience with scripting repeatable workflows preferred.Ability to build automated controls, validation checks, and audit trails that make reporting outputs traceable from published results back to source data.Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, including root-cause analysis, business logic validation, and the ability to challenge unreasonable outputs.Ability to simplify complex topics, translate data into clear business insights, and communicate recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.Strong ownership, accountability, and follow-through, with the ability to independently manage assigned deliverables from request intake through final publication.Collaborative team player with demonstrated integrity, openness to feedback, and commitment to continuous improvement.Experience with supply chain planning, inventory management, sourcing, product development, factory planning, or branded/fashion environment preferred.Prior experience supporting software rollouts, reporting enhancements, analytics tools, or process-improvement initiatives preferred.Bachelor’s Degree in business, supply chain, analytics, engineering, data science, information systems, or related field required
WORKING CONDITIONSFast paced, entrepreneurial environment.

locationDetails: Củ Chi, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Reposted 1 week ago · Over 100 people clicked applyPromoted by hirer · Responses managed off LinkedIn
jobDescription:
About the job
About PandoraPandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 6,800 points of sale, including more than 2,700 concept stores.Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery using only recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.2 billion) in 2024.About Pandora Production VietnamPandora’s new jewellery crafting facility is located in the Vietnam–Singapore Industrial Park III (VSIP III), about 40 km north of Ho Chi Minh City. When fully scaled, the state-of-the-art facility will produce up to 60 million jewellery pieces annually and employ around 7,000 craftspeople. It is powered entirely by renewable energy and built to LEED Gold certification standards.About The RoleThe Business Data Analyst turns operational data into practical insights that help the plant reduce downtime, improve yield/quality, and run to plan. Working within Manufacturing Excellence and partnering day‑to‑day with Production, Engineering, and Quality, the role executes discrete analysis and reporting tasks: extracting data (especially from SAP), building and maintaining Power BI/Excel/Tableau dashboards, and delivering clear, actionable summaries for supervisors and managers. The analyst applies straightforward requirement‑gathering techniques, documents KPI logic, and follows agile ways of working to deliver increments reliably. While deep coding is not expected, comfort with data prep, basic SQL, and growing Power BI/DAX skills is important; light Python familiarity is a plus. The role reports to the Senior Manager, Manufacturing Excellence and focuses on execution, quality, and adoption rather than advanced modelingKey Accountabilities Elicit and clarify reporting/analysis requirements via interviews, quick workshops, and doc reviews; translate requests into structured user stories or requirement notes.Maintain alignment on objectives/scope; surface trade‑offs early and manage basic change requests with the stakeholdersExtract and prepare datasets from enterprise systems—especially SAP—plus spreadsheets and local sources; perform cleaning, joins, and basic checks for completeness/consistency.Build and maintain Power BI, Excel (incl. Power Query & pivots), and Tableau dashboards/reports to answer recurring questions and track KPIs.Perform ad‑hoc analysis (e.g., pareto, trend, variance, root‑cause slices) and summarize implications in plain language with clear visuals.Use production/quality data to spotlight opportunities in downtime, yield, scrap/rework, and cycle times; link findings to OEE levers (Availability, Performance, Quality).Provide simple, actionable recommendations that supervisors/engineers can trial within the shift or next sprint.Validate that dashboards/analyses answer the original questions; run sanity checks against source records and stakeholder expectations before release.Log small enhancement requests, prioritize with the lead, and retest before publishing updates.Apply basic data quality practices (accuracy, completeness, timeliness); raise issues to data owners/stewards; document logic, filters, and KPI definitions use.Provide quick reference guides / short walk‑throughs so end users can self‑serve; capture FAQs to reduce rework and support adoption.Work closely with Production Excellence, Engineering, and Quality to ensure analyses reflect real operations and constraints; escalate complex modelling requests to senior analysts/data scientists when needed
Job Requirements Bachelor's degree and above in Business Analytics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field or an equally strong analytical background.Power BI, Excel (advanced functions, Pivot Tables, Power Query), and Tableau for visualization/reporting.Familiarity with SAP data structures and extracting/transforming SAP data for analysis.SQL (basic querying) for joins/filters/aggregations; Python familiarity is a plus (not required) for light data prep.Understanding of DAX for Power BI measures and models is advantageousBreaks ambiguous requests into clear, answerable questions; verifies causes vs. correlations.Crafts concise narratives with visuals to drive action among non‑technical stakeholders.Clarifies expectations, confirms definitions, and manages small changes calmly.Attention to detail & quality orientation — checks numbers, filters, joins, and KPIs before sharing; keeps light documentation.Understands OEE, downtime categories, and yield/quality drivers to make insights practical.Delivers on time and to commitments; raises risks early.Comfortable expanding toolset (e.g., DAX in Power BI; basic SQL) to improve throughput over time.Seeks feedback, hands off cleanly to seniors for advanced methods when appropriate.

jobDescription:
About the job
We are Neumann Kaffee Gruppe. And we love coffee.For us at Neumann Kaffee Gruppe (NKG), everything revolves around coffee. As a globally active green coffee service group, our more than 3,300 employees in 28 countries work with dedication for and with green coffee, which is always the focus of our services along the entire coffee supply chain. title: Data Engineer
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 1 week ago · 34 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
jobDescription:
About the job
Build and maintain the data pipelines and warehouse (DWH on ClickHouse) that power analytics and reporting across Vietnamworks/microsites. Ingest and integrate data from operational and CRM databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB; publish/subscribe integration, stored procedures) and product analytics (PostHog). Keep data reliable, fresh and well-modeled; provide light database administration (performance tuning; ensure and test backup/restore); build reports and standardized metrics; and support business and product teams with trusted data and optimized queries.JOB DESCRIPTION:1. Data Pipelines, Warehouse & Quality: Build and run ELT pipelines (dbt (data build tool), orchestrated by Prefect) from operational sources (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch) and product analytics (PostHog) into the data warehouse (DWH on ClickHouse); model data and tune query performance. Run automated data tests (dbt tests); monitor freshness and schema drift; own data SLAs and handle data incidents.2. Databases & Administration (DBA scope): Manage operational and CRM databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MongoDB), including a publish/subscribe (pub/sub) model and stored procedures. Handle performance and index tuning; ensure and test backup/restore and recovery. Heavy infrastructure operations and on-call sit with DevOps/Infra.3. Reporting & Insight: Build reports and dashboards (Metabase) and standardize core metrics so teams share one definition. Turn business questions into trusted analysis and insight for product and business decisions, using product analytics (PostHog).4. Data Support & Query Optimization: Handle data tickets and ad-hoc requests from business and product teams; write, review and optimize SQL (performance tuning).5. Security, Privacy & Compliance: Role-based access (RBAC), PII masking/encryption and audit logging; data retention and erasure. Controls to support Decree 13/2023/ND-CP, with Legal/DPO.REQUIREMENTS:• Bachelor in Computer Science, IT, Data or equivalent.• 4+ years in data engineering or equivalent data/database work.• Built and operated ELT/ETL pipelines into a data warehouse.• Built reports/dashboards and standardized metrics that others used for decisions.• Strong SQL (analytical + operational); Python for data work.• Hands-on with production databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL); performance tuning and backup/restore.COMPETENCIES/SKILLS:• Strong SQL and Python; Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD.• Data pipelines & warehouse: dbt (data build tool) + an orchestrator (Prefect / Airflow / Dagster); ClickHouse; data quality (dbt tests, freshness & schema drift).• Databases & DBA: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB; pub/sub integration; stored procedures; performance/index tuning; ensure and test backup/restore.• Analytics, reporting & security: PostHog (Amplitude / Mixpanel / GA4); Metabase (Superset / Redash / Looker Studio); RBAC, PII masking and audit logging; Decree 13/2023/ND-CP.• Behavioural: product mindset; clear communication with stakeholders; ownership; runs proofs of concept and adopts new technology.

jobDescription:
About the job
About the teamZalopay's Underwriting team owns credit decisions end-to-end for BNPL and cash loan products serving millions of users, in partnership with leading banks and consumer finance companies — from a user's first visit through submission, approval, disbursement, and repayment. We decide who gets offered credit, monitor how the portfolio performs, and build the data that proves whether we were right.What you'll do Monitor the portfolio: build and maintain the reports and dashboards that track the health of our lending book — approval rates, funnel conversion, delinquency by cohort.Investigate: when a number moves and nobody knows why, you're the detective — deep-dive the data, separate real risk changes from mix shifts and data artifacts, and land on the root cause.Own the data foundation: keep our core data assets — the end-to-end lending funnel and portfolio labels — correct, reconcilable, and trusted; chase reliability issues in partner data and drive the fixes.Shape underwriting strategy: turn your analysis into recommendations for whitelist expansion and the refinement of our underwriting rules.Collaborate on models and policy: analyze credit model performance with our data scientists and review new lending policies, pointing out flaws and opportunities before they go live.Communicate: translate your findings into clear, actionable insights for the business, product, engineering, and data science teams you work with daily.

Nice-to-have Consumer lending / credit risk analytics: funnel and approval analytics, DPD/MOB cohorts, vintage and roll-rate analysis.Credit model validation and backtesting.E-wallet, fintech, or payments background.Dashboarding (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and pipeline tooling (Airflow, ETL).

Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.The team you will be part ofOur Tech Team is the engine behind our digital capabilities—designing and building the platforms, tools, and systems that power our services across the eCommerce ecosystem. From automation to optimization to data integration, the team turns complex challenges into seamless solutions, enabling scale, speed, and smarter decision-making. With innovation at its core, Tech drives the digital backbone of our business and empowers every function to perform at its best.The part you will playWe are seeking a skilled AI Consultant to accelerate automation and productivity across all departments of our e-commerce enablement business. This role will identify repetitive, high-volume tasks; evaluate automation opportunities; design AI-powered workflows; and drive deployment of solutions that reduce operational effort, increase speed, and ensure accuracy or enhance performance.You will work closely with cross-functional teams to map processes, uncover automation opportunities, build prototypes, and collaborate with tech teams to deploy production-ready AI solutions. Consulting & Analytical Skills Strong problem-solving with ability to break down complex workflows and translating business problems into solutionsAbility to evaluate ROI and prepare business casesComfortable leading workshops, interviewing stakeholders, and synthesizing insightsExcellent communication skills and experience working with cross-functional teamsStay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend new applications

This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.Grow Without LimitsLearning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. title: Business Analyst (HCM/ HN)
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Reposted 2 weeks ago · Over 100 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
jobDescription:
About the job
ResponsibilitiesAs a Business Analyst, you take ownership of requirement analysis and work independently across projects. You will apply best practices from past experience to deliver clear requirements and help the team stay aligned with business goals. You are expected to understand the full picture of how systems work and support junior BAs by sharing knowledge and guiding their work. This role suits those with 3-5 years of experience and strong understanding of at least one business domain. Collaborate with clients to elicit, gather, and clarify business and stakeholder requirements and provide solution recommendations based on system understanding and project context Communicate requirements effectively to offshore teams to ensure shared understanding and alignment. Analyze and structure solution requirements into functional and non-functional deliverables such as System Requirement Specifications for RUP projects or detailed product backlogs for Agile engagements. Prepare and maintain functional deliverables such as user stories/use case descriptions, process diagram flows, and basic wireframes or mockups to support requirement communication. Review test flows and requirements coverage to ensure completeness and alignment with business needs. Understand the full system behavior and end-to-end business processes; analyze and reverse-engineer existing systems to identify dependencies, risks, and describe them clearly in requirement specifications for the project team Manage and track requirements throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring traceability and alignment with defined scope from analysis to final sign-off Share knowledge and guide junior BAs through direct feedback, document reviews, and practical coaching Contribute to proposal and bidding activities, including early-stage analysis, scope definition, and solution suggestion, especially in domains where you have relevant experience Leverage AI-powered tools to automate BA related activities/tasks, when required
Qualifications Good English communication skills and interpersonal skills, both written and spoken for stakeholder engagement tasks. Proactively applies AI-augmented tools to improve the quality and efficiency of BA deliverables. Bachelor's degree preferably in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Intelligence, or a related field, a Master degree is a plus. 3-5 years of experience in business analysis or a similar IT role. Solid understanding of software development processes and how different delivery models work. Familiarity with different types of requirement documentation (e.g., BRD, FRD, SRS, use cases, epics, themes, user stories, acceptance criteria) and capable of defining Definition of Ready and Definition of Done from a requirement perspective. Proficient in business analysis tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Figma, Visio, Camunda, or similar tools. Hands-on experience with technical tasks such as writing SQL queries, reviewing API specifications, and understanding system behavior, including basic cloud or integration architecture in real project environments. Solid understanding of development and testing fundamentals, including basic programming concepts and common testing approaches and techniques used throughout the software lifecycle Proactive and can-do attitude with the ability to work effectively across different project types, business domains, and cross-functional teams Experience supporting proposal or bidding activities as part of professional growth. Strong understanding of business processes with hands-on experience in at least one specific domain (such as insurance, fintech, logistics, healthcare, manufacturing, or education); open to learning and adapting to various business models and industries Professional certifications (IIBA-CBAP, PMP-PBA, IIBA-CPOA) are highly valued. Willingness to travel abroad for a short period; a valid passport must be ready and available.
What makes working with us special: 13-month salary per year.Performance bonusSocial – Health – Insurance paid fully.Healthcare: Annual health check-up,Premium Health InsuranceAnnual leaves: 14 days.Clubs program: Football, Badminton, Swimming, Tennis, Rock, Yoga....Training courses: Technical skills – Soft skills – English

jobDescription:
About the job
Role PurposeSenior Business Development phải thể hiện được khả năng phát triển khách hàng doanh nghiệp Tiêu dùng nhanh (FMCG), bán lẻ/ F&B, phân phối điện máy, giáo dục/spa/dịch vụ, ô tô & bất động sản. Quy mô khách hàng cỡ trung và cỡ lớn, doanh nghiệp nội địa hoặc doanh nghiệp nước ngoài hoạt động tại Việt Nam. Đối tượng tiếp cận bán hàng trực tiếp sẽ là các CMO, Marketing Director, các trưởng phòng ban phụ trách Media, Activation, Digital.Đối tượng tiếp cận bán hàng gián tiếp là các Planner, Account Manager, Director của các Agency có tập khách hàng liên quan Tiêu dùng nhanh (FMCG), bán lẻ/ F&B, phân phối điện máy, giáo dục/spa/dịch vụ, ô tô & bất động sản.“This role is responsible for driving new business, account retention, and revenue expansion across enterprise clients and strategic partners.”Key ResponsibilitiesA. Business Development (BD) - 80%Manage the full business development cycle, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to proposal development, deal negotiation, and contract closure. Chủ động tìm kiếm, xây dựng và phát triển quan hệ với khách hàng mới và đối tác mới trong các ngành mục tiêu.Nghiên cứu sản phẩm, giải pháp và năng lực triển khai của công ty để tư vấn đúng nhu cầu khách hàng.Giới thiệu giá trị sản phẩm một cách ngắn gọn, rõ ràng và thuyết phục trong nhiều bối cảnh khác nhau như cuộc gọi ngắn, trao đổi 1:1, networking, coffee chat hoặc các buổi pitching chính thức.Tìm hiểu mô hình kinh doanh, bối cảnh vận hành, bài toán tăng trưởng và các vấn đề thực tế mà khách hàng đang gặp phải để đề xuất hướng tiếp cận phù hợp.Khai thác nhu cầu, đặt câu hỏi đúng trọng tâm, xác định pain points và chuyển hóa thành cơ hội bán hàng cụ thể.Dẫn dắt toàn bộ quá trình phát triển cơ hội kinh doanh: từ kết nối ban đầu, qualifying, discovery meeting, proposal/pitching cho đến đàm phán thương mại và chốt hợp đồng.Xác định đúng các bên tham gia trong quá trình ra quyết định của khách hàng, bao gồm người ra quyết định, người ảnh hưởng, người ủng hộ và người phản đối; từ đó xây dựng kế hoạch tiếp cận phù hợp theo từng stakeholder.Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan như Product, Delivery, Customer Success, Finance hoặc các team nội bộ khác để hoàn thiện proposal, phương án triển khai và commercial terms.Theo dõi pipeline bán hàng, cập nhật cơ hội kinh doanh, tiến độ xử lý và forecast doanh thu định kỳ.Báo cáo kết quả công việc, cơ hội mới, tình trạng deal và các rủi ro/đề xuất lên Line Manager theo tuần/tháng.
B. Account Management & Revenue Expansion – 20%Manage the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding coordination, account development, renewal, and upsell opportunities. Là đầu mối quản lý các khách hàng được phân công sau bán hàng, đảm bảo quá trình triển khai và phối hợp nội bộ diễn ra liên tục, hiệu quả.Theo sát tình hình sử dụng dịch vụ, xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh và duy trì mối quan hệ tốt với khách hàng.Thực hiện review định kỳ với khách hàng về hiệu quả dự án/campaign, tổng hợp báo cáo và đề xuất các cơ hội mở rộng dịch vụ.Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để đảm bảo chất lượng dịch vụ, tiến độ triển khai và mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng.Quản lý quá trình tái ký, thanh lý hợp đồng, hỗ trợ thu hồi công nợ và thúc đẩy tăng trưởng doanh thu trên tập khách hàng hiện hữu thông qua upsell/cross-sell khi phù hợp.Đề xuất các hướng phát triển account, mở rộng nhu cầu và cải thiện retention rate.
RequirementsMust-have Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm trong các vai trò Business Development, Sales, Account Management hoặc Client Growth, ưu tiên trong môi trường Agency, MarTech, AdTech, Digital Marketing, SaaS hoặc các mô hình solution selling liên quan. Có khả năng xây dựng quan hệ với các decision-makers hoặc influencers phía khách hàng như CMO, Marketing Director, Head of Digital, Brand Lead hoặc các cấp quản lý tương đương trong các ngành mục tiêu.Có năng lực khai thác nhu cầu, đặt câu hỏi tốt, tư vấn giải pháp, trình bày proposal và thương thảo thương mại với khách hàng.Có tư duy consultative selling / solution selling, hiểu cách bán hàng trong môi trường nhiều stakeholder và chu kỳ bán hàng không ngắn.Kỹ năng giao tiếp, đàm phán và thuyết phục tốt bằng tiếng Việt; có khả năng làm việc bằng tiếng Anh trong môi trường kinh doanh.Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Quản trị kinh doanh, Marketing hoặc các ngành liên quan.Sử dụng tốt Google Workspace và các công cụ làm việc văn phòng.
Nice-to-have Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với enterprise brands hoặc khách hàng có quy mô lớn.Có hiểu biết hoặc từng bán các giải pháp liên quan đến CDP, Data, Digital Marketing, CRM, AI hoặc Automation.Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với CRM tools, quản lý pipeline và forecast bán hàng.Có trải nghiệm làm việc với agency network hoặc strategic partner ecosystem.Có khả năng tham gia pitching cùng team solution/product trong các deal phức tạp.
Skills & Attributes Kỹ năng giao tiếp, xây dựng quan hệ và tạo ảnh hưởng tốt.Tư duy kinh doanh và khả năng nắm bắt cơ hội thị trường.Chủ động, bền bỉ, có tinh thần ownership cao.Tư duy hệ thống, khả năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề.Quản lý công việc tốt, chịu được áp lực doanh số và tiến độ.Yêu thích công nghệ, cởi mở với các mô hình sản phẩm/data/AI mới.Có khả năng làm việc độc lập nhưng vẫn phối hợp hiệu quả với các phòng ban liên quan.
Benefits Lương cạnh tranh theo năng lực + lương tháng 13 + Quarterly KPI Bonus khi đạt target team.Overachievement Bonus: 5% trên doanh thu vượt, được phân bổ theo mức độ đóng góp thực tế của từng cá nhân.Tham gia đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định pháp luật.Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hàng năm.Được đào tạo và làm việc trực tiếp trên các dự án CDP, Data, AI và Enterprise Go-To-Market với khách hàng lớn.Cơ hội làm việc trực tiếp với C-level và Enterprise clients trong các dự án chiến lược.Hỗ trợ đào tạo và phát triển chuyên môn theo lộ trình nghề nghiệp rõ ràng.Lộ trình thăng tiến lên Head of Delivery & CS theo năng lực và kết quả.Môi trường làm việc trẻ, nhanh, ít bureaucracy, tập trung vào hiệu quả.Team building, company trip và hoạt động nội bộ.Chính sách làm việc linh hoạt và hỗ trợ chi phí công việc (di chuyển, gặp khách hàng, công tác...).
Working Time & Leave Thời gian làm việc: 8h30 – 18h00, từ Thứ Hai đến Thứ SáuNghỉ trưa từ 12h00 đến 13h30Nghỉ lễ, Tết và các ngày nghỉ theo quy định của Nhà nước Việt Nam.

Chủ động tìm kiếm, xây dựng và phát triển quan hệ với khách hàng mới và đối tác mới trong các ngành mục tiêu.Nghiên cứu sản phẩm, giải pháp và năng lực triển khai của công ty để tư vấn đúng nhu cầu khách hàng.Giới thiệu giá trị sản phẩm một cách ngắn gọn, rõ ràng và thuyết phục trong nhiều bối cảnh khác nhau như cuộc gọi ngắn, trao đổi 1:1, networking, coffee chat hoặc các buổi pitching chính thức.Tìm hiểu mô hình kinh doanh, bối cảnh vận hành, bài toán tăng trưởng và các vấn đề thực tế mà khách hàng đang gặp phải để đề xuất hướng tiếp cận phù hợp.Khai thác nhu cầu, đặt câu hỏi đúng trọng tâm, xác định pain points và chuyển hóa thành cơ hội bán hàng cụ thể.Dẫn dắt toàn bộ quá trình phát triển cơ hội kinh doanh: từ kết nối ban đầu, qualifying, discovery meeting, proposal/pitching cho đến đàm phán thương mại và chốt hợp đồng.Xác định đúng các bên tham gia trong quá trình ra quyết định của khách hàng, bao gồm người ra quyết định, người ảnh hưởng, người ủng hộ và người phản đối; từ đó xây dựng kế hoạch tiếp cận phù hợp theo từng stakeholder.Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan như Product, Delivery, Customer Success, Finance hoặc các team nội bộ khác để hoàn thiện proposal, phương án triển khai và commercial terms.Theo dõi pipeline bán hàng, cập nhật cơ hội kinh doanh, tiến độ xử lý và forecast doanh thu định kỳ.Báo cáo kết quả công việc, cơ hội mới, tình trạng deal và các rủi ro/đề xuất lên Line Manager theo tuần/tháng.
B. Account Management & Revenue Expansion – 20%Manage the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding coordination, account development, renewal, and upsell opportunities. Là đầu mối quản lý các khách hàng được phân công sau bán hàng, đảm bảo quá trình triển khai và phối hợp nội bộ diễn ra liên tục, hiệu quả.Theo sát tình hình sử dụng dịch vụ, xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh và duy trì mối quan hệ tốt với khách hàng.Thực hiện review định kỳ với khách hàng về hiệu quả dự án/campaign, tổng hợp báo cáo và đề xuất các cơ hội mở rộng dịch vụ.Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để đảm bảo chất lượng dịch vụ, tiến độ triển khai và mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng.Quản lý quá trình tái ký, thanh lý hợp đồng, hỗ trợ thu hồi công nợ và thúc đẩy tăng trưởng doanh thu trên tập khách hàng hiện hữu thông qua upsell/cross-sell khi phù hợp.Đề xuất các hướng phát triển account, mở rộng nhu cầu và cải thiện retention rate.
RequirementsMust-have Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm trong các vai trò Business Development, Sales, Account Management hoặc Client Growth, ưu tiên trong môi trường Agency, MarTech, AdTech, Digital Marketing, SaaS hoặc các mô hình solution selling liên quan. Có khả năng xây dựng quan hệ với các decision-makers hoặc influencers phía khách hàng như CMO, Marketing Director, Head of Digital, Brand Lead hoặc các cấp quản lý tương đương trong các ngành mục tiêu.Có năng lực khai thác nhu cầu, đặt câu hỏi tốt, tư vấn giải pháp, trình bày proposal và thương thảo thương mại với khách hàng.Có tư duy consultative selling / solution selling, hiểu cách bán hàng trong môi trường nhiều stakeholder và chu kỳ bán hàng không ngắn.Kỹ năng giao tiếp, đàm phán và thuyết phục tốt bằng tiếng Việt; có khả năng làm việc bằng tiếng Anh trong môi trường kinh doanh.Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Quản trị kinh doanh, Marketing hoặc các ngành liên quan.Sử dụng tốt Google Workspace và các công cụ làm việc văn phòng.
Nice-to-have Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với enterprise brands hoặc khách hàng có quy mô lớn.Có hiểu biết hoặc từng bán các giải pháp liên quan đến CDP, Data, Digital Marketing, CRM, AI hoặc Automation.Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với CRM tools, quản lý pipeline và forecast bán hàng.Có trải nghiệm làm việc với agency network hoặc strategic partner ecosystem.Có khả năng tham gia pitching cùng team solution/product trong các deal phức tạp.
Skills & Attributes Kỹ năng giao tiếp, xây dựng quan hệ và tạo ảnh hưởng tốt.Tư duy kinh doanh và khả năng nắm bắt cơ hội thị trường.Chủ động, bền bỉ, có tinh thần ownership cao.Tư duy hệ thống, khả năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề.Quản lý công việc tốt, chịu được áp lực doanh số và tiến độ.Yêu thích công nghệ, cởi mở với các mô hình sản phẩm/data/AI mới.Có khả năng làm việc độc lập nhưng vẫn phối hợp hiệu quả với các phòng ban liên quan.
Benefits Lương cạnh tranh theo năng lực + lương tháng 13 + Quarterly KPI Bonus khi đạt target team.Overachievement Bonus: 5% trên doanh thu vượt, được phân bổ theo mức độ đóng góp thực tế của từng cá nhân.Tham gia đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo quy định pháp luật.Khám sức khỏe định kỳ hàng năm.Được đào tạo và làm việc trực tiếp trên các dự án CDP, Data, AI và Enterprise Go-To-Market với khách hàng lớn.Cơ hội làm việc trực tiếp với C-level và Enterprise clients trong các dự án chiến lược.Hỗ trợ đào tạo và phát triển chuyên môn theo lộ trình nghề nghiệp rõ ràng.Lộ trình thăng tiến lên Head of Delivery & CS theo năng lực và kết quả.Môi trường làm việc trẻ, nhanh, ít bureaucracy, tập trung vào hiệu quả.Team building, company trip và hoạt động nội bộ.Chính sách làm việc linh hoạt và hỗ trợ chi phí công việc (di chuyển, gặp khách hàng, công tác...).

locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · Reposted 1 week ago · Over 100 people clicked applyPromoted by hirer · Responses managed off LinkedIn
jobDescription:
About the job
Yum! Digital & Technology is on a mission to revolutionize the QSR industry through Byte by YUM—our cutting-edge, all-in-one digital commerce platform powering iconic brands including Taco Bell, KFC, and Pizza Hut around the globe. Byte is transforming how millions of customers discover, engage with, and order from their favorite brands across web, mobile, CRM, loyalty, and digital marketing experiences.We are looking for a Business Analyst – CRM & Marketing Technology to join our Taco Bell Digital team. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of Digital Commerce, Customer Engagement, Marketing Technology, and Product Delivery, partnering with global and market stakeholders to drive both platform enhancements and customer-facing marketing initiatives.You will play a critical role in supporting CRM campaigns, digital content management, and customer engagement programs while helping scale Taco Bell's digital ecosystem across international markets. Working closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, UX, and Engineering teams, you will gather and translate business requirements, coordinate cross-functional delivery, support campaign execution, and ensure seamless customer experiences across web, mobile, email, push notification, and loyalty channels.ResponsibilitiesBusiness Analysis & Requirements Management Collaborate with franchisees, marketing teams, and internal stakeholders to understand, analyze, and document business requirements for digital commerce, CRM, and customer engagement initiatives.Analyze and document current and future-state business processes, workflows, and customer journeys.Create and maintain detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional documentation in JIRA and Confluence.Partner with engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications and validate solutions against business objectives.Facilitate requirement clarification sessions and support Agile ceremonies to ensure alignment across stakeholders and delivery teams.Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and project reviews to ensure stakeholder alignment and engagement.
Marketing Technology & CRM Operations Support the execution of global and market-level marketing campaigns, promotions, and CRM initiatives across digital channels.Manage and coordinate content publishing activities through Contentful CMS, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of campaign content.Support CRM campaign setup, testing, audience segmentation, and deployment activities within platforms such as Braze, Zeta, or equivalent marketing automation tools.Collaborate with Marketing and Analytics teams to define campaign tracking requirements and validate data collection for performance measurement.Assist in monitoring campaign performance, identifying optimization opportunities, and supporting reporting initiatives.Ensure marketing technology implementations align with data privacy, governance, and compliance requirements.
QualificationsRequired Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Marketing Technology, or a related field.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.Excellent English communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence.Familiarity with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and digital analytics concepts.Experience participating in at least one end-to-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) project through successful production launch.Experience working within Agile delivery frameworks such as Scrum or Kanban.Ability to work effectively across business, marketing, and technical teams in a fast-paced environment.Experience in QSR, retail, eCommerce, digital commerce, or consulting environments is preferred.
Preferred Skills Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Zeta, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar tools.Experience with Contentful or other CMS platforms.Understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, personalization, customer segmentation, and omni channel customer journeys.Familiarity with digital marketing technologies, customer data platforms (CDPs), tag management solutions, and campaign analytics.Experience supporting email, push notification, in-app messaging, and loyalty program initiatives.Knowledge of A/B testing, conversion optimization, and customer engagement measurement.Understanding of data privacy, consent management, and marketing compliance requirements.Experience working with global stakeholders and distributed teams.
Why You'll Love Working Here 100% salary during probation periodAnnual Leave: 18 days/ yearFive “Recharge Days” – Extra days, in addition to company holidays.2 days WFH/ weekFlexible Friday afternoonFull salary insurance13th-month bonus1 day off for birthdayAdvanced health insurance (Generali)Regular engagement activities: sport clubs, internal event…Support Macbook and Monitor
Working location: Block C, Waseco building, 10 Pho Quang, Tan Son Hoa ward, Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam

title: Business Solution
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN HAI BỐN BẢY (247Express)
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 5 days ago · 30 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Company review time is typically 1 week
jobDescription:
About the job
I. COMPANY DESCRIPTIONHAI BON BAY JOINT STOCK COMPANY (247Express) is a reliable delivery and logistics solutions provider in Vietnam, serving more than 20,000 corporate customers nationwide. Established in 2005, the company has more than 20 years of experience in the logistics industry. 247Express was recognized among the Top 10 Most Reputable Logistics Brands in Vietnam in 2024. The company focuses on reliability, customer satisfaction, and continuous service improvement to support business growth and operational efficiency.II. JOB DESCRIPTIONA. Position Vision The Business Solution (BS) position is responsible for translating business directions, issues, and needs from the BOD, Executive Management, and departments into clear, aligned, feasible, and implementable Business Solutions before moving to the Product Solution stage.The role goes beyond requirement gathering or Business documentation. The BS proactively conducts R&D and leads stakeholders in clarifying business problems, AS-IS/TO-BE processes, Business Rules, scope, and cross-functional/cross-domain impacts. The ultimate goal is to help the business identify the right problem and operating approach before the Product team transforms it into product and system solutions.
B. Business Problem Clarification & Business Solution Development Problem Statement Analysis: Receive directions, issues, or needs from the BOD, CPO, PM, and departments; identify the actual problem to be solved, root causes, affected stakeholders, scope, and expected business outcomes.R&D with Business/BOD: Proactively organize and lead R&D sessions with the BOD, Executive Management, and business units to clarify Business Processes, Business Rules, policies, applicable conditions, exceptions, and decision-making points.Business Solution/BRD Development: Take responsibility for developing or leading the development of Business Solutions and BRDs that are sufficiently clear to answer: Who does what – When – Under what conditions – According to which rules – What are the exceptions – What is the final outcome.
C. Process Design & Business Rules Management AS-IS & TO-BE Analysis: Study actual operations, analyze current processes, pain points, and root causes; propose future processes oriented toward faster execution, fewer errors, less manual work, and better control.Business Rules Management: Ensure that Business Rules are clearly defined, consistent, have a defined scope of application, applicable/non-applicable conditions, exception handling procedures, and designated decision-making authorities.Cross-Domain Impact Assessment: Proactively identify the impact of changes on departments, processes, data, reports, and business, management, and operational domains.
D. Business – Product Alignment Lead Result-Oriented R&D: Each working session must aim toward a Decision, Business Rule, Process, Solution Option, or Action Plan. If further research is required, clearly define the required scope, PIC, timeline, and decision-making date.Product Collaboration: Work closely with PM/PO throughout the R&D process. The BS is responsible for defining the correct business problem and Business Solution; the PO is responsible for transforming the Business Solution into Product Solutions, Epics/Features/User Stories, and coordinating implementation with Tech.
III. PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONSA. Education & Experience Minimum 4 years of experience in Business Analysis, Business Process, Operations, Business Consulting, or equivalent roles.Direct experience in researching, analyzing, and improving complex business processes; experience working with multiple departments, management levels, or the BOD to finalize Business Requirements and Business Solutions.Preferred: Candidates with experience in logistics, express delivery, transportation, supply chain, enterprise technology, or environments with multiple domains and closely interconnected operational processes.
B. Professional Skills Ability to analyze Problem Statements, Root Causes, AS-IS/TO-BE Processes, Business Rules, Business Data, Exception Cases, Dependencies, Risks, and Success Metrics.Ability to conduct R&D and clearly develop documents such as Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Business Solutions, Business Processes, Business Rules Catalogs, Decision Logs, and Impact Assessments.Strong systems thinking and the ability to understand the end-to-end impact across User – Business – Process – Data – Product – System; proactively identify cross-departmental and cross-domain dependencies.Preferred: Experience with BPMN, Value Stream Mapping, Root Cause Analysis, stakeholder facilitation, or actual operational surveys.Proficiency in tools supporting R&D and document/task management such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Draw.io, or equivalent tools.
C. Personal Attributes Bachelor's degree from a full-time university program with Excellent/Good academic performance from a National University, Foreign Trade University, or University of Economics. Preferred majors: Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, Information Systems, or Economics.Strong critical thinking and systems thinking; ability to ask the right questions, analyze problems, facilitate discussions, and drive stakeholders toward decisions.Strong communication and presentation skills; ability to work directly with the BOD, Executive Management, business departments, Product, and Tech teams in a fast-changing environment.
IV. BENEFITS & COMPENSATION Competitive income, 13th-month salary+, and performance-based bonus schemes.Empowered to directly participate in strategic business problems, operational processes, and change decisions with broad enterprise-wide impact.Friendly working environment with direct exposure to the BOD, Executive Management, Product and Tech teams, and hands-on operational units.
V. APPLICATIONInterested candidates are requested to submit their CV (soft copy or hard copy accepted) through the following channels: Email: tram.cao.thuy.mai@247express.vnAddress: Samco Building, No. 326 Vo Van Kiet Street, Cau Ong Lanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City

ABOUT THE JOB At NAB Vietnam, we are on an exciting transformation journey to build a modern data and analytics ecosystem that accelerates operational performance, deepens customer understanding, and drives productivity improvements across the organization As the Manager, Reporting & Insights, you will play a critical leadership role in establishing and advancing our enterprise reporting and analytics capability. You will help shape a centralized data foundation, creating a trusted single source of truth while ensuring data quality, accessibility, and governance across the business Leading a team of data professionals, you will deliver meaningful reporting, analytics, and insights that provide clear visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities. Partnering closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will translate complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and business outcomes. YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and develop a team of data analysts and engineers to deliver high-quality reporting and insights. Develop analytics, dashboard reporting for dedicated executives and functional leaders, foster trust in data by applying data risk governance principles. Leverage insights from data to anticipate future requirements to support decision making. Partner with stakeholders to define, track and enhance performance metrics, ensuring alignment to business priorities. Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform decision making and highlight risks and opportunities. Ensure data quality, governance and consistency across reporting outputs. Provide people leadership including performance management, quarterly check-ins and end-of-year outcomes, fostering an engaged and high-performing team culture. Drive continuous improvement and standardisation of reporting and insights practices across the function.
YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCE Experience 10+ year experience in leading and delivering analytics and insights solutions from prototyping to product development and deployment, experience in working across the business to support cross-functional performance improvement. Experience with preparing business cases with estimation, requirements and implementation plan of the use cases, helping stakeholders to build value-adding analytics to drive decision making. Experience with coaching, mentoring and support of data team to build an engaging and collaborative team culture. Experience with analysing and manipulating complex, high volume data sets using SQL, Spark (Databrick) and/or Python, MS PowerBI with multiple user roles. Working experience in a data consulting environment is a plus.
Qualification Requirements Bachelor/Master degree in business, data analytics/ computer science, statistics or related discipline
THE BENEFITS AND PERKS We appreciate and reward our colleagues who do great work every day - from excelling for our customers, to taking ownership of an issue to get it resolved. Here's how we support our people with a range of exclusive benefits. 1. Generous compensation and benefit package Attractive salary
20-day paid annual leave and 7-day paid sick leave
13th month salary and Annual Performance Bonus
Premium healthcare for yourself and family members
Monthly allowance for team activities
Premium welcome kit and occasional gifts of appreciation
Extra benefits on your work anniversary
2. Exciting career and development opportunities Large scale products with modern technologies in banking domain
Clear roadmap for career advancement in both technical and leadership pathways
Access to digital learning platform such as Udemy
Consistent and high-quality leadership training through the Distinctive Leadership program (DLP)
Specialist capabilities and accreditations in key skill areas such as Cloud Engineering, Digital, Data, Security and SREs (Site reliability engineers)
Sponsored English course with native teachers
Opportunity for training in Australia
3. Professional and engaging working environment Hybrid working model and excellent work-life balance
State-of-the-art & modern Agile office
Food and beverages in the office pantry
Employee Assistance Program to improve your physical and mental health
Annual team activities and company events
A solid and talented team behind you - great people who love what they do
A DIVERSE AND INCLUSIVE WORKPLACE WORKS BETTER FOR EVERYONE We know that our people make us who we are. That's why we have built a culture of respect - where everyone feels valued and appreciated for being their true authentic selves at NAB. With our focus on inclusion and diversity, and in partnership with our Employee Resource Groups, NAB is a place where First Nations colleagues, colleagues of all genders, sexualities and ages, carers and colleagues with disability, and colleagues from all cultures, races and religions have the opportunity to thrive, connect and grow. We are intent on providing an environment where you can work your way. Ask about our many flexible work options and please let us know if we can provide any adjustments throughout the recruitment process. CLOUD-FIRST NAB is undergoing an exciting "Cloud First" technology transformation by taking advantage of the latest tools and techniques used by leading technology and digital companies globally. But it's not just about the Tech, we are also investing heavily in our people, so if you have an appetite to learn, grow and elevate others around you, this is the place for you! If this excites you, let's have a chat over a cup of coffee! It's more than just a career at NAB!We believe in people with people and dreams, and we want you to achieve your aspirations. More than just a career, NAB Vietnam offers you a flexibility to balance your work - life, the opportunity to grow as professionals, people and a complete set of well-being offerings. If you have an appetite to learn, grow and elevate others around you, this is the place for you. IT'S MORE THAN MONEYWe naturally also provide a very competitive remuneration package but a career with us is about a lot more than money. We believe in people with ideas and dreams, and we want you to achieve your aspirations. We will work together to deliver exceptional products and outcomes that push the limits of our own aspirations. Our passion for creating value and exceeding our customers' expectations means we are constantly striving to redefine our standards of excellence. You will have our backing to develop and our encouragement to explore, realize and reach your full potential.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst, Zalo Business Solutions
locationDetails: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam · 1 week ago · 65 applicantsPromoted by hirer · Actively reviewing applicants
requirementsSummary: What you will need At least 4 years in data analytics or business intelligence, including ownership of a data model or reporting layer that other teams relied on;Strong data modeling skills (dimensional and star schema, semantic layers) and experience defining governed, consistent metrics as a single source of truth;Advanced SQL;Strong analytical thinking and business judgment, with the ability to own deeper analysis as the role grows;Analytics design: shaping existing data into the right metrics and specifying new tracking when needed;Experience with AI-assisted or automated reporting, or a strong drive to build it: comfortable prompting AI tools, giving them the right context, and checking their output;Has owned an analytics or reporting project end to end and communicates clearly with engineering, product, and business. People management is not required.

Nice to have Python for data analysis and automation (for example Pandas);Hands-on experience with Apache Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or Metabase;Experience making data ready for AI tools, such as semantic layers, documentation, or text to SQL;Experience across both product analytics and business or commercial data;Experience with large scale data environments, or with B2B.
responsibilitiesSummary: Zalo Business Solutions (ZBS) is Zalo comprehensive suite of solutions that empowers businesses to operate, advertise, and serve customers effectively within the Zalo ecosystem. Our mission is to provide standardized and scalable tools that help enterprises and SMEs reach customers securely and optimize automated engagement workflows.We are hiring a Senior Product Data Analyst to own the data foundation behind ZBS: the data model, the metric definitions, and the accuracy of the numbers we make decisions on. You will also build the reporting that runs on top of it, where better data lets AI deliver more, not just faster. This is a hands-on senior role with a lot of autonomy, sitting within a product team with engineering support for the pipeline work. Your first focus is to enhance the existing foundation and reporting so they are AI-ready. As the platform matures, you will grow into deeper analysis and decision support.What you will doBuild the data foundation and metrics Shape data that is already collected into clean, well defined metrics that product and business teams can trust;Define and document the data model so metrics stay consistent across ZBS. When something is not yet captured, write the tracking specification and work with the PO and engineer to add it;

Build the reporting layer (primary focus) Build and tune reporting that produces accurate dashboards, clear narratives, and useful guidance on what is going well and what needs attention, using AI to generate it;Automate recurring reporting and cut the manual effort behind it, bringing in the business context the numbers need to make sense;Keep the data model and metric definitions documented and rich enough for AI to produce correct, consistent output, and own how reporting is done for the team;

Turn data into decisions (grows over time) Investigate the why behind the numbers and turn it into clear recommendations the team can act on;Run funnel, cohort, retention, and segmentation analyses, and measure the impact of changes with A/B tests or before-and-after comparisons;Use AI to surface and explain routine patterns, and dig in yourself on the questions that need real analysis;Be the data partner that product and business teams rely on when making decisions.

About the job
About the JobDo you think like a management consultant, thrive in a high-growth environment, andcan't stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and business strategy?Are you the person clients turn to when the problem is complex, the stakes are high,and the path forward isn't obvious yet?With over 2,500 employees, 36 offices on five continents, and world-class clients likeSamsung, LOréal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data intomeasurable value and business impact. We're growing our SEA presence and want youto join us as a cornerstone of our team.Who We AreFounded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firmspecializing in data, analytics, and AI consulting — dedicated to transforming data intobusiness impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We don't just advise; webuild, implement, and deliver results our clients can measure.We have 2,500 employees across 36 offices focused on accelerating digitaltransformation for some of the world's most recognizable brands. Our state-of-the-artdata technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of elite businessconsultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are alllaser-focused on delivering real value to every client. We design data-driven solutionstailored to each client's specific needs — always conceived with a business-first mindset and delivered with tangible, measurable results. Our expertise is built on deep AIknowledge acquired through 1,000+ client engagements across the globe.Find out more at artefact.com.What you will be doingAs a Senior Data Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data, technology, andbusiness, turning complex datasets into actionable insights for our clients.Your key responsibilities will include: Defining client needs through in-depth discovery – conducting structured interviews and needs assessments with client teams across business units to surface the real problem beneath the stated onePerforming advanced data analysis and rigorous research to solve high impact, strategic challenges that matter to our clients’ bottom lineBuilding, formulating and presenting data driven strategic recommendations that are compelling, actionable and boardroom-readyContributing to business proposals that win – translating Artefact’s capabilities into clear, persuasive value propositions for prospective clients across SEAWorking across cross-functional teams to drive implementation of recommendations that drive meaningful changeTaking ownership of project delivery – ensuring workstreams are aligned, on schedule, and meeting client expectations, with support from a Manager or Director
What We Are Looking ForWe're looking for proven leaders and sharp thinkers who are ready to make their mark— people who bring a point of view, thrive in ambiguity, and hold themselvesaccountable to outcomes, not just outputs. As a member of our team, you'll help definewhat excellence looks like at Artefact in this market. We'll give you the platform and thetools to do your best work — and you'll arrive ready with the following: Undergraduate degree with strong academic performance; advanced degree (MBA or MSc in a quantitative field) is a significant assetMinimum 2-3 years of full-time experience in one or more of the following: consulting, data/analytics, marketing, finance, or tech — with a clear track record of client-facing delivery and independent problem-solvingExceptional verbal and written communication skills; you can represent Artefact with confidence and credibility at the senior client levelDemonstrated ability to lead and collaborate across diverse, multicultural teams; strong intercultural communication skills are essential in our global environmentAdvanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; Prior experience with either SQL, Python, or R is a mustExperience with data visualization tools, such as Tableau, Power BI, Google Analytics is a strong differentiatorGenuine passion for data, digital, and the broader tech and AI economy — you follow this space because you love it, not because you have toA natural teaching orientation and demonstrated ability to mentor junior team members; you make the people around you betterDeep knowledge of strategy consulting and/or digital marketing — within a consultancy, start-up, or agency — is highly desirable
Why You Should Join UsAt this stage in your career, you have options. Here's what makes Artefact different:Real ownership, right away. We're building our SEA practice, which means yourcontributions don't disappear into a bureaucracy — they shape the trajectory of anentire market. The decisions you make now will define how Artefact grows across SEA.Work that's actually at the frontier. Our clients aren't asking yesterday's questions.You'll be tackling problems where AI and advanced analytics are actively reshapingindustries — and you'll be expected to contribute to conversations with SEA’s mostambitious organizations.A global network that makes you better. With 36 offices worldwide, you'll tap intomethodologies, expertise, and colleagues across every major market. Our scale givesyou resources; our culture gives you autonomy. You'll bring global best practices to theSEA market — and contribute SEA’s insights back to the world.We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise: There is always a way — We're builders, diggers, and makers. Ideas only count if they get executed.Client trust is won in the field — We show up where it matters, working side by side with our clients to solve what's real.If not used, it is useless — We build for adoption and impact. True brilliance is measured by what changes, not what's delivered.If not shared, our work is not done — Sharing knowledge is how we close the loop — for our clients and for each other.We learn every day — In a field moving at the speed of light, intellectual curiosity isn't optional. It's survival.

Timo's data volume and stakeholder demand are growing faster than the current Data Analyst team's capacity, driven by expansion across lending (PayLater/Timo Credit), deposits (GoalSave, Term Deposit, CD), and payments.This role creates a senior layer within the team: a technically strong analyst who can own complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end, represent data insights directly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, and manage a small pod of junior analysts — freeing the Head of Data to focus on strategic and cross-departmental priorities.A day in your life might include1. Data Analysis & Technical Delivery• Own end-to-end analysis for high-priority initiatives (e.g., lending, deposits, cards, new user onboarding), from framing the business question to delivering the recommendation.• Write efficient, well-documented SQL and Python (pandas) to extract, clean, and model data from the Group's warehouse (Athena, dbt).• Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting (Holistic Dashboard) that reduce ad-hoc requests to the team.• Design and evaluate experiments (A/B tests), cohort, funnel, and segmentation analyses to support product and growth decisions.• Own, set, and enforce data quality, documentation, and analytical rigor standards and event tracking across the team's outputs.2. Insight Generation & Stakeholder Communication• Translate complex, technical analysis into clear, decision-ready narratives for non-technical audiences, including senior management.• Present findings and recommendations directly to stakeholders across Product, Business, Risk, and Compliance — including trade-offs, confidence levels, and limitations.• Partner with Product and Business teams to define success metrics and KPIs for new initiatives before launch, not just measure them after.• Proactively surface trends, risks, and opportunities from data, rather than only responding to inbound requests.3. Team Leadership & Capability Building• Manage and mentor a small pod of junior Data Analysts: allocate work, review quality, and support their technical and career development.• Establish and maintain team best practices — coding standards, QA checklists, and analysis templates — to keep output consistent as the team scales.• Act as the working-level bridge between the Head of Data and junior analysts: unblock issues, manage delivery timelines, and escalate where needed.• Contribute to onboarding new analysts and to the team's broader learning & development plan.How to succeed in this roleMust-Have• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or another quantitative field.• 4–6 years of hands-on data analysis experience, ideally in fintech, banking, or a fast-scaling tech/e-commerce environment.• Strong SQL and proficiency in Python (pandas) for data manipulation and analysis.• Working experience with BI/visualization tools (e.g., Metabase, Redash, Tableau, Power BI, Holistics, Mode, or similar).• Proven track record of presenting data-driven recommendations to senior stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication.• Some prior experience mentoring, coaching, or informally leading junior analysts.Nice-to-Have• Experience with modern data warehousing and transformation tools (Athena, BigQuery, Redshift, Snowflake, dbt, etc.).• Familiarity with product/CRM analytics platforms (Amplitude, MoEngage, AppsFlyer, Firebase).• Exposure to lending, payments, or digital banking data and regulatory context.• Experience designing and interpreting statistical experiments (A/B testing).Core Competencies• Critical thinking: questions assumptions and framing, not just the request as written — gets to the real business problem.• Executive communication: can simplify complex analysis into a clear recommendation for a non-technical, senior audience.• People management fundamentals: coaching, feedback, prioritization, and accountability for a small team's output.• Stakeholder management: comfortable working across Product, Business, Risk/Compliance, and occasionally external partners.Success Measures - First 2 Months• Independently owns and delivers analysis for at least one major cross-functional initiative.• Junior analyst pod is fully onboarded, with clear work allocation and a visible reduction in the Head of Data's day-to-day oversight load.• At least one recurring manual/ad-hoc reporting need converted into a self-serve dashboard.• Demonstrated ability to present directly to senior stakeholders without needing the Head of Data as a buffer.

jobDescription:
About the job
About UsWe are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in premium home theater seating and automotive furniture under the Seatcraft and Qualitex brands. We sell across our own websites and major marketplaces, and we're building out our Ho Chi Minh City office as a key part of our global team. You'll work closely with our Vietnam colleagues and collaborate daily with our design and marketing team in the United States.The RoleWe're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who brings a sharp modern aesthetic and a forward-thinking approach to design. You'll create visuals across e-commerce, digital marketing, email campaigns, social media, and product presentation — work that reaches hundreds of thousands of customers.This isn't a traditional design job. We expect you to be fluent in AI tools and use them actively as part of how you work — not as a novelty, but as a genuine part of your creative process.What You'll Do Design graphics for product pages, email marketing, paid ads (Google, Meta), and social mediaCreate promotional banners, lifestyle visuals, and brand assets for our Shopify-based websites and Amazon storesBuild and maintain email design templates in KlaviyoCollaborate with our US-based design, marketing, and product teams across time zonesIterate quickly on creative concepts using a blend of Figma and AI-assisted workflowsMaintain a consistent, clean, and modern visual brand across all touchpoints
What We're Looking For Figma is your primary tool — you're fast, organized, and build clean component-based filesAI is part of your daily workflow — you actively use tools like Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, or similar to ideate, generate, and refine visualsFamiliarity with Shopify and designing within its ecosystemExperience with or willingness to learn Klaviyo for email template designA modern, clean aesthetic — your portfolio reflects contemporary design sensibilities: sharp layouts, intentional typography, refined use of colorStrong written English communication skills for cross-team collaborationSelf-motivated and comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced environmentE-commerce or product design experience is a plus
What We Offer A collaborative, international team environmentReal creative ownership — your work is seen by real customers, not stuck in a drawerOpportunity to grow with a company expanding its Vietnam presenceCompetitive compensation
