Job Description Summary

The AKA Commercial Analyst, Pricing & Costing will support the AKA Commercial Leader, Pricing & Costing in driving governance, standardization, and execution excellence across high-impact commercial opportunities. The role is responsible for conducting pricing and costing analyses, supporting deal reviews, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and maintaining effective commercial governance processes. Through strong financial acumen and attention to detail, the analyst will help enable timely deal closure while ensuring compliance with internal policies, Delegation of Authority (DOA) requirements, and established commercial review processes.

GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities


 Deal Project Management & Execution
Support the Commercial Leader - Pricing & Costing in managing Pricing & Costing analysis of key strategic deals and business-critical projects.
Monitor the deal pipeline across current and upcoming quarters, proactively identifying priorities and facilitating readiness discussions.
Coordinate internal deal preparation activities, including cost sheet reviews and cross-functional alignment among Commercial, Product, Finance, OTR, HPM, and other stakeholders.
Support the coordination of deal review discussions with Local Country Teams (LCT) and AKA leadership by preparing materials, tracking action items, and facilitating stakeholder follow-through.
Track deal timelines, milestones, and action items to support timely deal closure and adherence to review requirements.
 Deal Margin & Cost Review
Conduct detailed cost and margin reviews to ensure accuracy, and completeness.
Validate cost sheets against solution configurations and business assumptions.
Perform pricing simulations under multiple scenarios and provide analytical insights to support cost optimization and margin improvement discussions.
Perform Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, franchise margin analysis, margin allocation assessments, and profitability evaluations.
 Governance & Standardization of MMD/Big Deal Process and DOA
Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of deal review frameworks in alignment with Global Markets guidelines and best practices.
Assist in maintaining review criteria, governance requirements, workflows, and documentation standards.
Standardize deal review templates, pricing models, and cost sheet structures to improve consistency, efficiency, and accuracy.
Support the execution and administration of the Deal Review Operating Mechanism for LCT and AKA leadership teams.
Prepare consolidated reporting, dashboards, and executive summaries of key strategic deals for leadership review.
 Pricing Operation and Excellence Support
Support pricing structure enablement activities, including target loading, standard setting maintenance, DOA approval workflow administration, NPI activation, and other pricing-related processes.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and governance of CPQ and Pricing Margin Analysis tools and outputs.
Identify and recommend continuous improvement opportunities to enhance pricing, quoting, and commercial operations processes.
Support the implementation of best practices, process standardization, and operational excellence initiatives across the pricing function.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in commercial operations, pricing, finance, business analytics, or related functions.
Proficiency in pricing tools, CPQ systems, Excel-based financial modeling, and commercial analytics.
Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to connect operational drivers to financial outcomes, evaluate alternatives, and identify opportunities for business improvement.
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and experience supporting cross-functional projects and process improvement initiatives.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex financial and commercial information into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across different levels, functions, and geographies.
Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, including confidence, professionalism, and the ability to influence decision-making in a matrixed environment.
Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and evolving business requirements.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced organization.
High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism, with a strong commitment to compliance and governance standards.


Desired Characteristics


Confidence and assertiveness: ability to communicate data-driven recommendations confidently and work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders while ensuring compliance with established policies and governance requirements.
Experience in a global business environment with an understanding of international processes and transactional flows.
Fluency in spoken and written communication.
Adaptability and flexibility in dynamic environments.
Strong ethical standards and adherence to high moral values in decision-making and interactions.


Inclusion and Diversity

GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Data & AI
locationDetails: Làm việc từ xa (Remote)
jobDescription:
About the job

Are you passionate about helping organizations unlock business value through data, analytics, and AI?

Do you enjoy working with business leaders and technical teams to transform complex challenges into innovative data-driven solutions?

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape AI, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives within one of Vietnam's fastest-growing markets?

 

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations harness the power of data, AI, and cloud technologies to accelerate business transformation. We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst – Data & AI to act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring that data, analytics, and AI solutions deliver measurable business outcomes for our customers.

 

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will work closely with clients, architects, data engineers, and project teams to shape and deliver Data & AI initiatives. Leveraging your strong understanding of the Vietnam market and banking industry, you will help customers identify business opportunities, define requirements, and translate strategic objectives into scalable data and AI solutions.

 

Key responsibilities:

Leading discovery workshops and stakeholder engagements to gather, analyze, and prioritize business requirements for Data & AI initiatives.
Defining functional specifications, user stories, process flows, data requirements, and business rules that guide solution delivery.
Partnering with customers to identify, evaluate, and prioritize data, analytics, AI, and GenAI use cases that deliver measurable business value.
Acting as the liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring alignment throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Supporting user acceptance testing, data validation, and solution adoption activities to ensure successful outcomes.
Contributing to proposals, solution scoping, and client engagements while helping shape SoftwareOne's Data & AI offerings within the Vietnam market.
Job Requirements 
Experience working as a Business Analyst on Data, Analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of business process analysis, requirements management, and stakeholder engagement.
Knowledge of modern data and analytics platforms, cloud technologies, and business intelligence solutions.
Experience working with banking or financial services organizations and understanding of the regulatory and operational landscape.
Excellent communication skills in both Vietnamese and English, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills with a proactive and customer-focused mindset.
Company description 

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI. 

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference. 

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

title: Managing Consultant, Advisor & Consulting Service , Deploy
locationDetails: Làm việc từ xa (Remote)
jobDescription:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Managing Consultant, Advisor & Consulting Service , Deploy

Overview

Make an Impact as a Managing Consultant, Deploy is an execution-oriented, client-facing competency that applies proven program management, change capabilities, and domain expertise to partner with clients and drive measurable value by:


 Delivering new products and strategies to market smoothly and efficiently
 Successfully implementing complex technology assets and leading large-scale transformation programs to create the new business as usual
 Strengthening client’s internal skills, knowledge and experience in critical areas
 Transforming client processes and optimizing their management practices
 Owning end-to-end delivery outcomes and driving measurable business impact across the full lifecycle of client initiatives
 Acting as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders to influence decisions and maximize value realization



________________________________________

All About The Role

Deploy is a suite of consulting solutions designed to respond to fast evolving customer needs for execution support, with a dual mission: deployment and value realization over the entire lifetime of major assets. Value realization is a complex task, and Deploy helps de-risk the entire client/asset journey—from implementation to adoption, usage, and product evolution—through expert execution support that complements traditional Advisors capabilities.

As a Managing Consultant, you will lead complex programs and/or multiple engagements independently, providing direction and leadership across a portfolio of work. You will drive efficient and effective execution of a broad range of activities by establishing clear governance, defining team structures, and aligning stakeholders to deliver expected business outcomes.

You Will


 Lead end-to-end program delivery across multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment to strategic client objectives
 Own governance, execution planning, and delivery tracking across complex initiatives
 Drive alignment across senior stakeholders, manage escalations, and ensure timely decision-making
 Proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring minimal impact on timelines and program outcomes
 Ensure delivery translates into measurable value realization and sustainable business impact
 Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities to expand engagements and support proposal development



All About You


 Undergraduate degree with work experience in project management and change management methodologies and techniques
 6+ years of Project Management experience
 Exposure to financial institutions, payments, and/or consultancies
 Experience coaching and managing teams across multiple projects and/or engagements with third parties
 Experience managing key client relationships
 Knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
 Ability to provide perspective on industry and marketplace
 Logical, structured thinking
 Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
 Ability to manage multiple tasks and clients in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
 Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable)
 Eligibility to work in the country where you are applying, as well as apply for travel visas as required by travel needs
 Ability to travel to client sites on a semi-regular basis



Preferred Qualifications


 Exposure to payments ecosystem including issuing, acquiring, or acceptance solutions, with preference for candidates with hands-on acquiring experience (e.g., merchant acquiring, payment gateways, POS solutions, or acceptance networks)
 Experience leading development and implementation of solutions and measuring impact on clients' business
 Have completed or interested in pursuing recognized professional accreditation, such as Project Management Professional (PMP)
 Knowledge of Project Management tools
 Exposure to payments and/or retail banking or merchants
 Experience generating new knowledge or creating innovative solutions for a firm
 MBA or master’s degree with relevant specialization (not required)



Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Graphic Designer
locationDetails: TP. Hồ Chí Minh
jobDescription:
About the job

About Us




We are a fast-growing US-based e-commerce company specializing in premium home theater seating and automotive furniture under the Seatcraft and Qualitex brands. We sell across our own websites and major marketplaces, and we're building out our Ho Chi Minh City office as a key part of our global team. You'll work closely with our Vietnam colleagues and collaborate daily with our design and marketing team in the United States.




The Role




We're looking for a talented Graphic Designer who brings a sharp modern aesthetic and a forward-thinking approach to design. You'll create visuals across e-commerce, digital marketing, email campaigns, social media, and product presentation — work that reaches hundreds of thousands of customers.




This isn't a traditional design job. We expect you to be fluent in AI tools and use them actively as part of how you work — not as a novelty, but as a genuine part of your creative process.




What You'll Do




Design graphics for product pages, email marketing, paid ads (Google, Meta), and social media
Create promotional banners, lifestyle visuals, and brand assets for our Shopify-based websites and Amazon stores
Build and maintain email design templates in Klaviyo
Collaborate with our US-based design, marketing, and product teams across time zones
Iterate quickly on creative concepts using a blend of Figma and AI-assisted workflows
Maintain a consistent, clean, and modern visual brand across all touchpoints







What We're Looking For




Figma is your primary tool — you're fast, organized, and build clean component-based files
AI is part of your daily workflow — you actively use tools like Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, or similar to ideate, generate, and refine visuals
Familiarity with Shopify and designing within its ecosystem
Experience with or willingness to learn Klaviyo for email template design
A modern, clean aesthetic — your portfolio reflects contemporary design sensibilities: sharp layouts, intentional typography, refined use of color
Strong written English communication skills for cross-team collaboration
Self-motivated and comfortable working in a growing, fast-paced environment
E-commerce or product design experience is a plus







What We Offer




A collaborative, international team environment
Real creative ownership — your work is seen by real customers, not stuck in a drawer
Opportunity to grow with a company expanding its Vietnam presence
Competitive compensation
